data.narrative:
Kodiak AI is a Series C-stage defense and security frontier-tech company that has raised $250M+. Valuation assessment relies on a peer set of 13 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, spanning both public equities (2 names) and private companies (8 disclosed). The peer universe ranges from $300M to $18.0B, with notable private comparables including Quantum-Systems ($8.0B, Series C), Helsing ($18.0B, Series D), and Saronic ($9.2B, Series D).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $250M raised proxy, implying a $425M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 13-company cohort yields a $2.1B median, with a floor of $300M and ceiling of $18.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in maturity, capital intensity, and commercial traction within the defense tech sector.

Blending these methods produces a triangulated valuation range of $361M (low), $1.3B (median), and $2.5B (high). The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around Kodiak AI's relative positioning within a peer set that spans two orders of magnitude. Key variables determining position within this range include revenue run rate, customer concentration, technology differentiation, and proximity to Series D-stage capital events evident among comparable firms.
